notes: Southern Front Range Colorado. Primary VA facility: Pueblo VA Medical Center (1008 Bermuda Ave, Pueblo CO 81001). Colorado Springs has a VA CBOC and Vet Center but no full VAMC — veterans needing inpatient or specialty care go to Pueblo VAMC or Eastern Colorado VA (Denver/Aurora). Fort Carson and Peterson/Schriever SFBs are major installation presence in El Paso County — TAP and ACS resources available on-base for transitioning service members. Significant Gulf War era veteran population in El Paso County — PACT Act (2022) and Gulf War Syndrome presumptives are high-value routing targets here. Data current as of 2026 — verify all contact info before production deployment.
gulf_war_note: El Paso County has a high concentration of Gulf War era veterans (1990–2001). Gulf War Syndrome is a VA presumptive — fibromyalgia, functional gastrointestinal disorders, and undiagnosed multi-symptom illnesses qualify without proof of nexus. PACT Act (2022) extended coverage. Veterans who were denied in the past should refile. Route to toxic-exposure-division for refile guidance.
